subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the combined user-facing report, or should maintainers route its remaining work to the active placeholder issue and the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn policy issue?
rationale: Current main fixes part of the report, but the remaining behavior spans active provider/session PRs and a separate replay-safety policy decision; automation should not choose the canonical split or merge direction alone.

options.title: Route Through Active Canonicals
options.body: Use the open placeholder issue and active PRs for model-visible tool-result text, and use the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn issue for retry/fallback policy before closing this issue later with links and proof.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the combined Discord/Telegram user-facing report until one merged fix and proof cover both placeholder and no-response behavior.

options.title: Close After Maintainer Split
options.body: A maintainer can close this issue now as a duplicate only after explicitly naming which canonical issue owns each remaining behavior and preserving the useful 2026.6.11 evidence there.

recommendation.title: Route Through Active Canonicals
recommendation.body: Use the open placeholder issue and active PRs for model-visible tool-result text, and use the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn issue for retry/fallback policy before closing this issue later with links and proof.
